products.title: Electric Gynaecology Examination Chair

products.description: The Electric Gynaecology Examination Chair is designed to provide comfortable patient positioning and efficient clinical access during gynaecological examinations, ultrasound procedures, fertility treatments, and minor procedures. Its electric positioning system allows convenient adjustment of the chair through a wired hand controller, helping healthcare professionals achieve the required examination position with minimal manual effort. The chair features a comfortable upholstered surface, adjustable leg supports, armrests, an adjustable footrest, and a stable wheeled base for easy movement within the clinical environment. Its modern design and easy-to-clean finish make it suitable for contemporary gynaecology clinics, women's health centres, fertility centres, and examination rooms. Key Features Electric positioning: Height, backrest, and seat angle can be adjusted using the wired hand controller. One-touch operation: Simple handheld remote control allows convenient operation. Comfortable upholstery: High-density foam with soft medical-grade PU leather covering. Adjustable leg supports: Padded leg holders support appropriate patient positioning during examinations. Adjustable footrest: Multi-angle footrest provides additional patient support and positioning flexibility. Adjustable armrests: Designed to improve patient comfort during examinations. Acrylic treatment tray: Pull-out acrylic tray provides a practical and easy-to-clean treatment surface. Stable mobile base: Heavy-duty base with lockable wheels provides stability and allows relocation. Quiet motor: Electric motor is designed for smooth and quiet operation. Modern clinical design: Smooth contours and a contemporary finish suitable for modern healthcare environments. Multi-purpose use: Suitable for gynaecological examinations, ultrasound procedures, fertility treatments, and minor procedures.

products.description: The Jumper JPD-100E Fetal Doppler is a medical device designed for real-time fetal heart rate monitoring during pregnancy. The device uses a 2.5 MHz ultrasound probe and supports a fetal heart rate measurement range of 50–210 beats per minute (BPM), with a stated accuracy of ±2 BPM. The Jumper JPD-100E Fetal Doppler is suitable for use in maternity clinics, hospitals, and other healthcare settings as part of prenatal assessment.
